Questions

Before you book

It depends on roof size, pitch, condition and coating system. That's why the inspection is free — you get an itemised written quote, and we explain when a repair is enough instead of selling you a full restoration you don't need.
If the roof structure and tiles/sheets are sound, restoration usually gives you 10–15 more years at a fraction of the cost. If there's widespread rust, cracked tiles throughout, or structural issues, replacement is the smarter long-term spend. We'll show you photos and give you both options where both are viable.
Most repairs are done in a day. A standard restoration takes 2–4 days depending on weather and roof size. Full replacements are usually 3–7 days. You can stay in the home throughout in almost all cases.
Yes. We make the roof safe first, then provide photos and a written report your insurer can work from for the permanent repair.
